findings:
I ran the checks against commit ead532a0. I didn't edit any files, start any wallet or chain transaction, change visibility or publish. This was the project's local dev server, not a production build or the live site, and no wallet was connected at any point.

**Routes:** `/`, `/app`, `/app/agents`, `/app/dispatch` and `/docs` were each checked at 1280 px and 390 px wide.
- Every route returned 200 and showed its own heading.
- No page errors were recorded and no page scrolled sideways.
- On mobile, the app's top tab bar scrolls inside its own strip, so Launch, Dispatch and Agents start off-screen. The page itself doesn't scroll sideways.

**Keyboard and wallet dialog:** at 1280 px on `/app/agents`, Tab moves through Skip to content, the logo, CA, Settings, Connect wallet, then Terminal. At both sizes, pressing Enter on Connect wallet opens the wallet dialog and Escape closes it.

**/app/agents with no wallet:** Run check and Start monitoring are disabled, and the empty state offers Connect wallet, watch-only and practice options.

**Watch-only:** the address box has a proper label. An invalid address shows "Not a Solana address" and keeps Inspect disabled. The page says "This mode can never transact." I didn't inspect a real address, so loading real positions in watch-only mode is still unverified.

**Practice path (opted in), at both sizes:**
- The page clearly says "PRACTICE DATA" and describes the position as fictional.
- An unrecognised command ("make me rich") was refused with "Nothing was changed."
- "rebalance when out of range" filled in the rule settings.
- Arming showed "ARMED · REV 1 · BASELINE BIN 1002".
- After further checks, one rebalance proposal appeared: "bins 1001–1021", triggered because "Active bin 1011 is outside the range 990–1010". The 21-bin width was kept.
- Start monitoring switched to Pause, and Pause switched it back.
- Prepare review left monitoring paused and opened an in-page review (not a pop-up) saying "no transaction, no simulation and nothing to sign". Close dismissed it.
- The capital check showed active-bin holdings separately from holdings in the rest of the range, and said there's no pool comparison in practice mode.

**One unresolved observation (not confirmed as a defect):** in my first run I chose "Apply to parameters" and then clicked an arm button quickly afterwards. The rule ended up "saved, not armed · rev 1". My script found the button by a loose name match, so I can't tell whether it clicked the wrong button or whether the arm click was lost after saving. Arming worked every time when I clicked "Arm at bin …" directly.

**Not checked:**
- A connected real wallet, and real watch-only data such as positions, live volatility and the same-pair pool comparison.
- Any real review, simulation, signing or confirmation.
- The Dispatch page's live scan and controls (I only loaded the page).
- A production build, the published site, and screen-reader behaviour.

Real signed evidence still depends on your funded devnet acceptance run.

followup.findings:
The Apply→Arm issue was a mistake in my test script, not a product defect. The real watch-only address also loaded correctly, read-only. I found no defects. I made no edits, connected no wallet, sent nothing to the chain and didn't publish. All checks ran on the local dev server at 1280 px and 390 px wide.

**Apply→Arm (practice scenario), identical at both sizes:**
- **What went wrong last time:** once a rule is saved, the position card itself becomes a button, and its text contains "SAVED, NOT ARMED". My loose "Arm" search matched that card first and clicked it instead of the arm button. It never matched Disarm, which only appears after arming.
- **Steps with the exact button name:**
  - Start: "NOT ARMED · REV 0".
  - "Apply to parameters": "RULE: SAVED, NOT ARMED · REV 1".
  - "Arm at bin 1002": "RULE: ARMED · REV 2 · BASELINE BIN 1002 (0.00% SINCE)".
  - "Disarm": "RULE: SAVED, NOT ARMED · REV 3".
- No page errors and no sideways scrolling.

**Real watch-only address:**
- **Owner lookup:** reading position 1Be6ZXynELowU6JjN1VRR4pRMEeAywdgpQdeKJp44id with the installed Meteora toolkit gave owner **6mch5rCLBtZ9DCnM2mx18Ud1XXhXAip7otw9LkrTXwTD**. It is owned by the Meteora DLMM program, in pool 5rCf…HAS6, with range −5388 to −5343.
- **In the app:** I chose Watch-only, entered that owner, pressed Inspect, then Run check. Both sizes showed the same 8 SOL/USDC positions in that pool, with SOL at 9 decimals and USDC at 6. The active bin was −5389.
  - Position 1BE6…44ID: 46 bins, range −5388 to −5343, 0.428757 SOL and 0 USDC.
  - It shows "OUT OF RANGE", which is correct: −5389 is just below its lowest bin.
  - All 8 positions showed as out of range at the time of the check.
- **Spending is blocked:** the only actions that could move funds ("Review staged move") were disabled, and no sign or approve control appeared.
- **Rules are still allowed:** "Arm at bin −5389" was available, because rules here only observe.
- No page errors, no failed page requests and no sideways scrolling.

**Not checked:** monitoring or arming on the real watch-only data, the same-pair pool comparison and live volatility for the real positions, a connected wallet, a production build and the live site.
